title: New Shell Integration PowerToy: Copy as UNC
author: RamblingGeekUK
summary: The current upstream head needs changes before merge. The shell command has reliability and path-classification defects, sparse-package registration resolves external binaries from the wrong directory, the Windows/GPO/settings integration is incomplete, clean-build metadata is inconsistent, and the core behavior lacks focused automated coverage. The upstream branch also currently conflicts with main.
